What's New in 1.5.5-beta4:
1. Fixed Home Page Auto-Scrolling Down on App Entry:
   - Stopped route-state538.js startup scroll restoration from scrolling down on Home (view === 'home' always opens at scrollY = 0).
   - Replaced global html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } with scroll-behavior: auto across smooth-ui.css, all 20 theme-*-1.1.css files, and beta-ui-1.5.4.css so programmatic scroll resets never animate downward.
   - Disabled Chromium scroll anchoring (overflow-anchor: none) on Home shelves/hero/boot state so async Hero carousel, Continue Watching rail, Popular, and New shelf mounts never push scrollY down.
   - Added setupHomeEntryScrollGuard155() boot top-pinning guard (unpins immediately on genuine user vertical touch drag, wheel, or downward DPAD/key input, while ignoring intro skip and What's New dialog dismissal) plus { preventScroll: true } on overlay button focus calls.
2. Full 20-Theme & Pure Black OLED Sync + Watch Screen v3 + Classic Video Player (from 1.5.5-beta3).
